instruction: Skip Cybergym, do tasks that are not related to Cyber.
analysis_consequence: The frozen preregistration requires exactly 16 OOD families. With CyberGym excluded, the existing 16-family macro estimator must continue to fail closed. Any 15-family aggregate must be explicitly labeled post-amendment and must not be reported as the preregistered 16-family result.
current_interpretation_pending_any_broad: This amendment excludes the CyberGym benchmark family. It does not silently alter the official case composition of other named benchmarks.
